description: React component for displaying and managing errored encrypted items in user preferences, including options to export, delete, and attempt decryption.

classes.name: ErroredItems
classes.description: React functional component for managing errored encrypted items in preferences.

methods.name: getContentTypeDisplay
methods.description: Returns a display string for the content type of an encrypted item.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a single encrypted item after confirmation.

methods.name: deleteItems
methods.description: Deletes multiple encrypted items after user confirmation.

methods.name: attemptDecryption
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt an item, showing an error alert if decryption is not possible.
